about.title: About
paragraphs: Family business, virtual reality, car sales: for more than ten years, I have done the same job in different forms. Understand what people need, then offer them the right solution.
In 2020, in the middle of the pandemic, I also worked as a care attendant in a long-term care home (CHSLD). That experience strengthened what still guides the way I sell: listen before proposing.
